result.rationale: The diff shows GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now computes selectedCalendar = calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId with a 'primary' fallback, replacing the old direct use of destinationCalendar.externalId. EventManager's new fallback branch (destination without credentialId) calls createEvent(c, event) passing credential.id, so a legacy destination whose credentialId is null will never match the find(), and its configured externalId is ignored, falling back to 'primary' — a behavior regression introduced by this diff.
